# TRAVNY

> Canonical map of the public TRAVNY hub, services, machine-readable guides and small technical publications.

Canonical hub: https://travny.pages.dev/
Identity: TRAVNY (trvny / travny / trfny / trafny), with projects under the travnie GitHub organization.
GitHub owner: https://github.com/trvny/ · organization: https://github.com/travnie/

## Main routes

- [Hub](https://travny.pages.dev/) · [Markdown](https://travny.pages.dev/index.md)
- [TVPI](https://travny.pages.dev/tv/) · [Markdown](https://travny.pages.dev/tv/index.md)
- [TRAVNY Lab](https://travny.pages.dev/lab/): experiments and live widgets
- [Lab field notes](https://travny.pages.dev/lab/field-notes/): roadmap and experiments
- [Papagenerator](https://travny.pages.dev/papagenerator/): browser-only meme and sticker editor; images stay on the device
- [Teksty](https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/) · [Markdown](https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/index.md)
- [Tokenowy Mundial AI](https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/token-worldcup/): token-count comparison for equivalent text in 27 languages using `o200k_base`
- [GitHubowa Kraina](https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/githubowa-kraina/) · [Markdown](https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/githubowa-kraina/index.md): interactive atlas of the public `trvny` and `travnie` project landscape
- [The Alpaca, the Crab and the Censor (English)](https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/grass-mud-horse/): essay about Chinese internet slang and censorship
- [Alpaka, krab i Wielki Harmonizator (Polish)](https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/grass-mud-horse-pl/): Polish adaptation of the essay

- [Main Atom feed](https://travny.pages.dev/teksty/feed.xml): articles and Shitpost Reactor entries, live-aggregated

- [Streambench](https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/) · [LLM guide](https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt) · [full guide](https://streambench.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt)
- [Code Bench](https://codebench.travny.workers.dev/) · [LLM guide](https://codebench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt) · [full guide](https://codebench.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt)
- [Doc Bench](https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/) · [LLM guide](https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/llms.txt) · [full guide](https://docbench.travny.workers.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Usage notes

- TVPI upstream HLS signatures are short-lived. Prefer maintained TVPI Worker endpoints over short-lived tokenized upstream URLs.
- Weather is a multi-source local ensemble for Kościelec in Chrzanów with air quality, pollen and IMGW warnings.
- Streambench, Code Bench and Doc Bench are local-first browser tools; their own LLM guides document privacy and agent-access boundaries.
- Tokenowy Mundial AI is maintained as Quarto source in `trvny/trvny` and proxied by TRAVNY from its verified generated HTML.

## Agent access

On browser hosts implementing WebMCP, TRAVNY pages with the shared navigation expose `open_travny_destination`. It only starts navigation to destinations already present in the visible TRAVNY menu and does not accept arbitrary URLs.
